name: Toughened Suit [Psionic]
body:
When you call your astral suit, you strengthen it with a boost of energy.

Prerequisite: Astral suit class feature.

Benefit: Any time you form your astral suit, you can choose to pay 1 power point as part of the action to form the astral suit to gain 1 temporary hit point per aegis level you possess. These temporary hit points last until your astral suit is dismissed, destroyed, or otherwise ends.
